# DSH Work

> Status: developer-preview integration as of 2026-08-15. No production-ready
> release is available.

DSH Work is an independent, local-first office agent workspace built on
DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It is intended to turn project sources into reviewable
and editable deliverables such as reports, spreadsheets, and presentations.

The repository includes a pinned DSH Web Profile and an external
`@huiliyi37/dsh-office@0.1.6` bundle exposing bounded XLSX, PDF, PPTX, and DOCX
tools. Citation provenance, review UX, and approval-aware export are still
product milestones, not shipped claims.

The Models page currently supports pi-ai native browser OAuth for
`openai-codex`. OAuth credentials are stored under the DSH home credential
file and refreshed by pi-ai; the browser never receives token values. Other
providers remain API-key or adapter-specific integrations.

Core workflow: project sources -> specialized agent roles -> draft deliverable
-> citation and change review -> human approval -> export or external action.

DSH Work is not an official DeepSeek product, is not a replacement for
Microsoft Office, and does not currently ship a stable desktop application.

Primary source: https://github.com/HuangYuChuh/dsh-work
